title: Add RAG templates, agent tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG templates, agent/tool-calling example projects, and quickstart docs to the site to make it easier for engineers to get started with retrieval-augmented generation and multi-tool agents. Motivation: customers and community contributors repeatedly ask for runnable, opinionated examples that demonstrate tool-calling patterns, structured outputs, and configuration recommended for production inference. This change bundles: 1) three RAG template prompts (faq, product-docs, and customer-support) with annotations and suggested eval prompts; 2) two agent examples that show tool-calling (calendar booking + knowledge base search) implemented in TypeScript and Python; 3) quickstart pages in the docs site with step-by-step onboarding, configuration snippets, and troubleshooting tips; 4) updates to the redwood-examples CI so the agent samples run lightweight smoke tests on PRs; 5) a short migration note for existing RAG users describing canonical template fields and backward-compatible mapping. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and annotated examples - [x] Add TS and Python agent examples with README and smoke tests - [x] Dock docs quickstarts and code snippets into docs site - [x] Add CI smoke tests and update GH actions - [x] Add Linear tasks and reference tickets. Related: ENG-4721, ENG-4850. Docs preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-56085. Notes: examples are intentionally minimal but production-oriented (includes caching config, batch settings, and model hints). This PR does not introduce backend runtime changes or new public API surfaces; it is purely examples and docs with minor CI adjustments.

notes: Examples include recommended batching and caching hints for the Redwood inference runtime. Keep examples under 300 LOC to encourage readability. Follow-up: add an end-to-end tutorial video and a sample dataset for the product-docs template (ENG-4850).
